svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1013 commits across five public projects, 71 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-17 through 2026-11-08 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-08T01:21:39.042Z.
